/* ── Landing container ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.landing {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: #13392a;
  font-family: 'Cabin', sans-serif;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ── Hero section ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.landing-hero {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a4d33 0%, #1e5a3c 50%, #13392a 100%);
  padding: 1.4rem 2.5rem 1.2rem;
  border-bottom: 3px solid #b99b3c;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.landing-hero .uni-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: #b99b3c;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
}
.landing-hero h1 {
  font-size: 1.6rem;

  margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.landing-hero .desc {
  font-size: 0.88rem;

  max-width: 560px;

  line-height: 1.55;
}

/* ── Main content area ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.landing-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  background: #13392a;
}

/* ── Canvas area — card grid ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.landing-canvas {
  flex: 1;
  background: #faf8f2;
  padding: 2rem 2.5rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.chapter-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #8c7430;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}
.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}
.algo-card {
  background: #ece8d8;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: all 0.18s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.algo-card:hover {
  background: #fff;
  border-color: #b99b3c;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.algo-card .card-num {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #b99b3c;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.algo-card .card-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #13392a;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.algo-card .card-desc {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.algo-card .card-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  background: #1e5a3c;
  color: #d4e8db;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* ── Bottom bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.landing-bottom {
  height: 40px;
  background: #b99b3c;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.landing-bottom .bot-left {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.landing-bottom .bot-right {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
.landing-bottom .bot-pill {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* ── Responsive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .landing-body { flex-direction: column; }
  .landing-body #aa-sidebar {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .landing-canvas { padding: 1.5rem 1rem; }
  .card-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .landing-hero { padding: 2rem 1.2rem; }
  .landing-hero h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; }
}
</style>
